Left of the VLM: the inert glovebox, its automatic antechamber facing along the line, and the rePowder ultrasonic atomizer.
Right of it: the Aconity MIDI, the floor and tabletop Instrons (neither fits a tray: the shortest Instron frame is 1020 mm tall) and the wire EDM that cuts parts off their build plates.
The backup to the mobile base: a Vention rack-and-pinion seventh axis along the fronts, the UR10e on its carriage at 800 mm, as on the MiR250. It can carry the arm from machine to machine.
Not used by any workflow yet: it parks at the VLM's opening, where the MiR250 parks.
The whole line, about 17 m along the rail.
